title: SAH Project 32p
body:
I'm giving you a free version of the SAH Project pack in 32x32px resolution. It's fully compatible with vanilla and doesn't require any additional modding. Although shaders and things like Optifine will certainly add to its charm. Although the pack is designed for 1.21.11, it works with most earlier versions of Minecraft Java. The pack isn't fully ready yet, but it will be regularly updated with new textures. ### SAH Project Family: * SAH Project 32p is the full, free version of the pack in 32x32px resolution.
* SAH-Lite is a free, preview version of the package in 256x256px resolution, containing a limited number of textures.
* SAH Project 256p is the full version of the pack in 256x256px resolution, available on Patreon: https://patreon.com/user?u=53072343
* SAH Project GUI is the full version of the HD GUI texture pack available on Patreon: https://patreon.com/user?u=53072343 The GUI for the basic version of Minecraft is 100% complete. I systematically add elements to the most popular mods. I would be grateful for any suggestions for additional mods.I invite you to try it out.


💛 Thank you for supporting SAH Project
